{{Top|leg}}
The '''environmental droid''' was one of the five major subcategories of [[Class two droid/Legends|class two droid]], along with [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]], [[Engineering droid/Legends|engineering droids]], [[Explorer droid/Legends|exploration droids]], and [[Maintenance droid/Legends|sophisticated repair droids]]. Environmental [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were advanced models, similar to exploration droids, that were used in terraforming projects.<ref name="TNEGtD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
